executive_summary: Siemens has created digital twins for the University of Wollongong and the Amazon rainforest, showcasing their capabilities in digital transformation and automation.
Becamex IDC partnered with the World Bank on Khu Công Nghiệp Sinh Thái EIP 2.0, and with Sembcorp on Trung Tâm Đổi Mới Sáng Tạo Việt Nam – Singapore.
Honeywell launched the NOTIFIER INSPIRE platform, enhancing their product offerings in automation and fire safety sectors.
Johnson Controls launched Metasys 16.0, aiming to enhance their building automation and controls offerings.
NVIDIA expanded its Omniverse Blueprint for AI Factory Digital Twins, providing new capabilities and tools for creating digital twins.
